decisions.decision: Close this without asking Adi. Run one verification pass first. Use Playwright to load https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/workshop/ (header), /playbook.html and /deck.html with ?v=1009, at 1440 and 390 widths, in light and dark. Check each surface uses the right variant from tantra-logo-usage.md: ink mark on light backgrounds, white mark or lockup on dark. Also check that no white mark disappears on a white tile, the favicon and OG image resolve, there are no 404s on the brand assets, and there is no stretching or blur. If something is wrong, fix the source exports or the mapping in apply-logo.py, re-run it, republish the mirror using the documented procedure, and re-check. Log screenshots and results on T-082 and mark it done. Remove the 'Asked of Adi' line. The logo stays visible on T-020, T-093 and T-108, which already ask for his review, so it doesn't need a separate review task.
decisions.why: Adi designed this logo and sent the Canva exports himself (session 2026-09-23).
